records.title: Republican state Sen. Taffy Howard faces campaign finance crime allegation
records.description: A complaint against state Republican Senator Taffy Howard alleges improper campaign contributions violated state campaign finance law.

records.title: U.S. Supreme Court cases deal with cost of climate change, discrimination, death penalty
records.description: Mike Thompson previews U.S. Supreme Court arguments, from climate change accountability to habeas corpus in a death penalty case.

records.title: Officials say beloved Black Hills bald eagle died from lead poisoning
records.description: Hope, a famous bald eagle which roosted in Rapid City’s Canyon Lake neighborhood for nearly a decade, has died. An autopsy confirmed the cause was lead poisoning.

records.title: South Dakota's economy buoyed by federal ag assistance, state economic council says
records.description: South Dakota’s economy is a mixed bag, officials say. Part of that is the fact that farmers are getting a chunk of their income from the government, not markets.

records.title: South Dakota receives share of nationwide GM settlement over driver data misuse
records.description: South Dakota is receiving $2.6 million dollars in a settlement from General Motors over allegations the company illegally sold consumers’ data.

records.title: 'Yearslong process' to reduce state's recidivism rate requires money, culture changes
records.description: If South Dakota wants to see real change in its prison system as it pursues a stronger push for rehabilitation, it has a few things to clean up. While many are already underway administratively, it’s going to take time and cost some money, according to a report created for a legislative task force studying these issues.

records.title: Private lending is fueling the AI boom. How might that change the U.S. financial system?
records.description: Banks have grown, but non-bank lending has grown even faster. Joe Santos explains how private lending fuels innovation while opening the door to vulnerabilities.

records.title: Recent rain means delayed harvest but better spring for farmers, expert says
records.description: After what’s been a dry year, precipitation has increased recently in parts of South Dakota. It brings both short-term headaches and potentially long-term benefits to farmers.

records.title: State habitat fund receives nearly $8 million for grassland restoration initiative
records.description: A South Dakota organization is receiving nearly $8 million from the USDA to support a statewide grassland program.

records.title: Polls open in South Dakota for midterm elections
records.description: Tuesday is election day. South Dakota voters have several big decisions in front of them for this year’s midterm.

records.title: Productive struggle is key to learning. AI wants to eliminate it
records.description: Teachers Gina Benz and Jackie Wilber unpack the latest research into AI in the classroom, including the role of human teachers in understanding when students are working in the "sweet spot" for learning.
